why:
Most commands are fine. `npm test`, `npm ci` (package-lock.json is tracked), `node --test`, `git merge-base`, `gh pr view` and `gh pr checks` all fit this repository. The builder's step-5 example is valid shell and is only an illustration.

The verifier brief breaks the criterion. It says "Use a scratch temp directory for fixture files" and sets "BIN=packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js", which is relative to the repo root. Its commands then pass bare fixture names, like `node $BIN good1.jsonl bad.jsonl good2.jsonl`. Run from the repo root, good1.jsonl and the other fixtures don't exist there, so they would be reported as unreadable. Run from the temp directory, `$BIN` doesn't resolve. Either way, Checks 1–3 can't run as written and would give wrong results. Neither brief creates these files where the commands look for them.
